overview_description.description: K-Scale Labs develops embodied AI systems aimed at enhancing robot interaction with the environment. Its main product, K-Bot, is a humanoid robot platform designed for flexibility, capable of running various AI models and preloaded with K-Scale OS, an operating system that integrates multimodal AI for vision, language, and action. K-Scale OS is built using Rust to provide reliability and performance tailored for robotics workflows. K-Bot supports customization and repairability, allowing developers to adapt the platform to their needs. The company also offers open-source tools to help developers train, deploy, monitor, and debug humanoid robot applications. Additionally, it provides a cash-back program to encourage data sharing and reduce development costs.

about_short_description.short_description: K-Scale Labs is a robotic engineering company specializing in creating open-source humanoid robots.

product.name: K-Bot
product.description: A 4-foot general-purpose humanoid robot designed for developers to perform various tasks including chores and industrial applications.

product.name: Z-Bot
product.description: A 1.5-foot mini humanoid robot optimized for portability and affordability, used for education and research in reinforcement learning and robotics.

product.name: M-Bot
product.description: A 2.5-foot compact humanoid robot designed for home use, supporting deployment of AI policies and robot applications.

product.name: K-Sim
product.description: An open-source, GPU-accelerated reinforcement learning framework for training humanoid robot locomotion and manipulation policies with sim-to-real transfer.

product.name: K-VLA
product.description: A vision-language action policy framework that enables high-level motion planning and manipulation using language and vision inputs.

product.name: K-OS
product.description: A Rust-based robot operating system and runtime that manages hardware, software, and firmware integration for humanoid robots.
